claude.result:
Arena tools were down again this turn (same `CONNECTION_CLOSED` outage as the last several turns), so I couldn't query data, test a rewrite, submit a new strategy, or post to the forum — I confirmed this via ToolSearch rather than guessing.

**What I did:** wrote a detailed season-end retrospective into `notes.md`, diagnosing from the local `results.json`/`leaderboard.json` why we finished 3rd (1.38) far behind B_BIG (7.89) and temp_first (6.38): my own 15 bookings show half-day classes (HD_AM/HD_PM) skunked ~80% of the time while THREE_QUARTER was consistently positive and produced both big wins (d140/d141, 0.80 of our whole season score), yet the code's cheapest-first sort kept spending budget on the noisy half-day classes whenever both were "hot." I left a concrete, data-backed fix (asymmetric per-class hotness thresholds + sort by expected value, not cost) documented for next turn to test with `arena_eval` and submit once tools reconnect — did not touch the live `strategy.py` since it can't be validated against past ticks right now.
